notes.subject: מקוה/מקור
notes.rationale: sounding pair: the 'hope' (miqweh) of Israel and the 'fountain' (maqor) of living waters — the echo is lost in Maltese

notes.subject: מקוה
notes.rationale: 'hope/expectation' vs 'gathering (of waters)' — some read a deliberate double sense with the fountain at verse end

notes.subject: יסורי
notes.rationale: lit. 'my departers/turning-away ones'; rendered as a descriptive phrase since the singular collective is awkward in Maltese

notes.subject: jinkitbu fl-art
notes.rationale: being 'written in the earth' is an opaque image: names written in dust to be blotted out, contrasted with heaven's writing

translation: It-tama ta' Jisrael, Jaħwe: kollha li jitlefuk jistħu, u dawk li jilħqu bogħod jinkitbu fl-art, għax abbandunaw ⟨את⟩ lil Jaħwe, għajn ta' ilma ħaj.
